title: Rates And Tariffs 2025 — Residential
archive_note: Text of the page. The footer prints LAST UPDATED ON 26/05/2025 and the page is titled 2025, which is how we know it may not be the rates in force in 2026.
establishes: Expat apartment water: AED 7.84 per m3 Green and AED 10.41 Red, with a Green allowance of 0.7 m3 per day
That the band allowance is daily and set by dwelling type — the standardized 180 m3 a year is 0.492823 m3 a day, entirely inside Green
The separate elective UAE National tariff at AED 2.09 and 2.60, a concessionary class under §5.3 stored separately and never averaged
That ADDC's own tariff page states charges are inclusive of VAT at 5% from 1 January 2018
does_not_establish: Whether AED 7.84 contains the VAT or attracts it. The footnote reads both ways: the published rates already contain VAT (AED 117.60 at 15 m3), or the amounts charged will be VAT-inclusive so VAT is added (AED 123.48). U = 4.878%, which is Grade C under §5.2 — context or a range only, never a ranking. Settling it needs arithmetic from ADDC: the official calculator at a known volume, or a real invoice.

Whether a water account carries a recurring meter or service charge. This page shows none; secondary sources describe AED 7.84 monthly for expats attached to electricity, and AED 7.84 is confusingly also the water rate per m3. Dubai charges AED 5.00 for a Type 1 meter, so silence here is not absence.
Whether sewerage sits inside the water rate. Secondary sources say Abu Dhabi bundles it. If true this is the Toronto case; if false a wastewater component is missing. No services figure is computed.
That these are the 2026 rates. The page is titled 2025 and last updated 26 May 2025.
